name: probe-research-daemon
description: Probe Research, daemon profile: the Probe daemon records and reads the team's work for this agent. Installs instrument-code, the daemon's messages and questions, and the guard; no MCP.

interface.shortDescription: The Probe daemon records and reads for this agent

hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_PLUGIN_PROFILE=daemon; [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/tracking_guard.py" ] || exit 0; PY="$(command -v python3)" || exit 0; exec "$PY" "$ROOT/hooks/harness_io.py" tracking_guard.py'
